concept: A living protective membrane forms a P around a golden mother cell, paired with a clean wordmark.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one extraordinary standalone cinematic TITLE LOGO for the meditative microscopic strategy game "PETRIVERSE". This is a new, concept-driven identity: a compelling organic emblem paired with a refined clean wordmark. NOT a brand board, NOT a scene, NOT merely textured letters. Real transparent background.

Brand meaning: a tiny living world inside a petri dish; fragile life protected by an adaptive living colony. Calm wonder, evolution, connection, a complete universe in a drop of water. Design a memorable silhouette that would also work reduced to one color as an app icon.

The emblem: one sculptural, fluid, almost circular living membrane enclosing a tiny amber-gold mother cell. The blue membrane curls inward and extends in a gracefully tapered descending stroke, so the whole silhouette quietly suggests an uppercase P. The P should emerge naturally from this enclosing biological gesture; it should NOT be a literal typeset P filled with stuff. Think a circular petri-dish rim becoming a protective cellular ribbon. Make a beautiful clearly defined negative-space chamber with the small gold mother cell suspended inside, subtly off-center. The membrane has three gentle cellular swellings fused continuously into its rim, with exquisite microscopy detail visible only on close inspection. The surrounding open chamber stays mostly empty, emphasizing the mother cell and silhouette. A few microscopic pearl vesicles within the rim, subtly translucent doubled membrane, fine refractive edges, restrained cilia in one small region. A distinctive asymmetric organic shape, elegant and intentional, neither a generic ring nor a spiral galaxy. The clear specimen-like membrane is pale ice blue and silvery teal, and the single focal core is warm honey gold.

Wordmark: exact text "PETRIVERSE", spelled P E T R I V E R S E, ten letters on one line. Place beneath the emblem with generous clear separation. Sophisticated custom uppercase lettering, moderately wide proportions, balanced spacing, elegant slightly flared terminals, substantial readable strokes, luminous warm pearl with very subtle cool light on the edges. Clean letter interiors: no organelles, no embedded creatures, no cellular fill, no bubbles, no decoration inside the text. No chrome bevels. The shape of the letters and quiet optical refinement must make this feel like a beautifully designed premium indie game identity.

Composition: emblem centered above the title, forming one unified balanced compact title lockup. Emblem approximately half the wordmark width, occupying the upper two-thirds of the design; wordmark across the lower third. Clear margins around the entire mark. Entire asset visible, approximately 3:2 landscape canvas. Absolutely no background rectangle: preserve genuine alpha transparency including the emblem's negative spaces. No full-world scene behind it.

Rendering: astonishingly beautiful high-end cinematic biological sculpture, photographic translucent tissue, soft transmitted light, fine opalescent silver/cyan edge refraction, a restrained amber glow in the mother cell. Serene and alive. Strong identifiable silhouette is more important than detail density. Dark teal shadows only within the tissue, not as a backdrop. A few minute floating droplets close to the membrane only if they support the shape. No large glow cloud.

Avoid: letters filled with cells, horror slime, spiky medieval game crest, metallic esports badge, shield, generic atom symbol, planets, space stars, generic tech spiral, galaxy swirl, literal lab glassware illustration, cluttered creatures surrounding the name, giant lens flares, neon tubing, cartoon germs, stock biotech logo, multiple options, layout grids, mockups, extra text, tagline, watermark. One gorgeous, distinctive, finished Petriverse title identity.
